Morning all —

We need to lock the commit slate for the monthly scrub and assemble the leadership packet by EOD Monday. Key asks:

- Please update the attached Q4_commit_tracker.xlsx with final stage (Commit/Best vs. Upside) and a 1-line rationale for any movement.
- If you have any deals that require an exec note (SLA exceptions, custom pricing, or legal gating), add a row in the ‘Exec Attention’ tab and flag ownership.
- Pull the most recent win/loss notes into the exec_packet_template_v3.pptx (slide 3) — we want 1 slide per prospective >$250k.

I’m looping Karthik for pricing confirmations and Laura for the leadership packet intake. We’ll do a quick 20-min sync at 1pm to triage anything that blocks the assemble.

Attachments: Q4_commit_tracker.xlsx, exec_packet_template_v3.pptx

Thanks,
